annotations.title: Check a draft against engine results

description: Check a draft passage against the engine results computed in THIS session. It returns every figure no engine produced, and every claim it checks that the results do not support or contradict (for example a solver score called a loss), each in `findings` with the reason. Run it before publishing or handing over a report, fabrication sheet, BOM summary or any other figure-bearing deliverable built from these tools. It computes nothing and adds no evidence — it only reports what the results back. Fix each finding the way its `why` says: quote the engine's own value, call the tool that computes it, correct the wording, or say plainly in the text that the figure is not from a tool.

text.description: The draft passage to check, verbatim. Pass the prose the end user will actually read — including tables and captions, since a figure in a table is a figure. Markdown is fine.
